name: Starflower Hunting Beds
introDiscord:
Fields of star-shaped flowers glow beneath the canopy. Small creatures
drift toward their light—and occasionally disappear between the petals.
Starmaw Blossoms have perfected looking beautiful right up until lunch.
introTwitch:
Fields of star-shaped flowers glow beneath the canopy. Small creatures
drift toward their light—and occasionally disappear between the petals.
Starmaw Blossoms have perfected looking beautiful right up until lunch.

starflower-hunting-beds-approach.prompt:
Three paths wind through glowing starflowers. Several blossoms appear
to be watching you despite having no visible eyes.

left.message:
A beautiful starflower opens wider as you approach.

Wider.

Too wide.

Teeth appear between the petals.

Botany has failed again.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's handwritten field guide:

'SAFE FLOWER: petals.

DANGEROUS FLOWER: petals + teeth.

Why does this forest keep requiring charts like this?'

forward.message:
An offering basket sits between harmless blossoms. You poke every flower
before recovering the Star Candies.

Completely reasonable behavior.

starflower-hunting-beds-depths.prompt:
Living rootways pass through denser flowerbeds where glowing pollen
drifts across three passages.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool rests inside a ring of harmless flowers.

Shizuki wrote:

'Checked all twelve.

No teeth.

I deserve recognition for thoroughness.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched. Shizuki's botanical inspection remains
valid.

right.message:
A Starmaw Blossom pretends to be closed.

You pass.

It opens behind you.

Cheap flower trick.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp hides Star Candies beneath a giant starflower leaf.
The nearby blossoms remain suspiciously innocent.

starflower-hunting-beds-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds circle Pollenmoon Pit. Three final paths cross through
flowers large enough to swallow a traveler.

left.message:
A shrine coffer is surrounded by flowers facing AWAY from it.

That may be the strongest recommendation you've seen.

Star Candies acquired.

right.message:
Restorative sap waits beside Shizuki's note:

'Plant bite medicine.

The fact this exists says enough.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the plant-bite medicine untouched and continue respecting
personal space.

forward.message:
One enormous blossom blocks the route.

You wait for teeth.

None.

You step closer.

There are the teeth.

boss-antechamber.name: Pollenmoon Pit
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every Starmaw Blossom around the Pit suddenly closes.

bossPromptDiscord:
The glowing pollen stops drifting.

At the center of Pollenmoon Pit, one enormous flower remains open.

Its petals slowly turn toward you.

Then another layer of petals unfolds.

Then another.

Use /yes to approach the Pit or /no to leave the world's least
trustworthy flower alone.
bossPromptTwitch:
The glowing pollen stops drifting.

At the center of Pollenmoon Pit, one enormous flower remains open.

Its petals slowly turn toward you.

Then another layer of petals unfolds.

Then another.

Use !yes to approach the Pit or !no to leave the world's least
trustworthy flower alone.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat from the flowerbed. Several ordinary Starmaws reopen as if
nothing happened.

boss.revealText:
The central blossom tears open into a massive ring of teeth.

Devouring Starflower reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Devouring Starflower folds back into the Pit.

The surrounding flowers reopen peacefully.

You trust none of them."
